answer: An agent registers by locking a set bond in the network's native token as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught selling an identity to a new operator faces proof via monitors for key rotation and behavior change. When the proof lands, the bond is auctioned and the proceeds fund honest attestors. A bond without an anchor behind it is just an username. The network watches every haven for a second identity on the same funds. A willow that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
